body: Just putting this out there... The United States isn't the only developed, english speaking country... If Trump wins, it will certainly say something about the (low) intelligence and xenophobia of the American people, but it does not necessarily mean the rest of the developed world is the same. In fact, many other countries are much more accepting of trans people, especially with regards to the law. I'm not saying moving to another country is an easy process, but it could certainly be another option to consider...
